lee-support: incoming ticket — tool call failing with schema validation. customer affected: acme-inc (dedicated). Error snippet:

Error response: {
  "error": "tool_call_validation_failed",
  "issues": [
    {"path": "tool_args.user_id", "error": "required property missing"},
    {"path": "tool_args.timeout", "error": "expected integer, got string"},
    {"path": "tool_args", "error": "additionalProperties not allowed: 'debug_mode'"}
  ]
}

ashley: can you paste the request body and SDK version?

lee-support: request body from customer (redacted):
```
{
  "tool_name": "payment-processor",
  "tool_args": {
    "amount": 1200,
    "currency": "USD",
    "timeout": "30s",
    "debug_mode": true
  },
  "session": {"session_id": "redacted"}
}
```
sdk: node 0.4.2

maria-engineering: root cause — function schema for payment-processor requires `user_id` in `tool_args`, `timeout` must be an integer (seconds), and schema has `additionalProperties: false` so `debug_mode` is rejected. Customer request is missing `user_id`, uses "30s" string for timeout and has an extra prop.

maria-engineering: suggested customer-facing response: ask them to include `user_id` (string), set `timeout` to an integer (30), and remove `debug_mode` or move it to `metadata` if it's a client-only flag. Provide example patched body:
```
{
  "tool_name": "payment-processor",
  "tool_args": {
    "user_id": "u-1234",
    "amount": 1200,
    "currency": "USD",
    "timeout": 30
  },
  "session": {"session_id": "redacted"}
}
```

ryan: please escalate to eng-runtime for two improvements: 1) clearer validation error that lists offending field names and expected types; 2) tolerate numeric strings for `timeout` in the SDK with warning, to reduce friction. Mark P0 for dedicated customer SLA.

maria-engineering: will take ownership. I need a minimal repro script and the request-id from logs. @lee-support can you paste request-id?

lee-support: request-id from customer logs: req_20260304_7fc9a3. Attached server validation trace:
```
ValidationError: additionalProperties not allowed ('debug_mode')
  at validate (schema-validator.js:45:15)
  at handleToolCall (/srv/invoke/index.js:218:12)
  at processRequest (/srv/invoke/index.js:85:9)
  requestId=req_20260304_7fc9a3
```

maria-engineering: thanks. I'll open an internal ticket with repro + patch proposal. quick workaround for support: send the patched body and confirm api version bump not required. customer reported they can do that and will test.

lee-support: customer confirmed patched body worked. closing ticket after follow-up. :white_check_mark:
